exceptions.justification: Socket's AI anomaly heuristic flagged the published code; it names no concrete behavior to change, and the code it reviews is the package's own functionality.
exceptions.alternatives: None: the heuristic gives no actionable finding to act on.
exceptions.remediation: Re-check after the next release; the finding is attached to the already-published artifact.

exceptions.justification: Socket flags packages with little adoption. data-cap is young, and adoption cannot be produced by code; the alert is a property of the package existing at this stage of its life.
exceptions.alternatives: None: the only way to avoid the alert is not to publish the package.
exceptions.remediation: Resolves on its own as adoption grows; nothing to change in the code.

exceptions.justification: The package ships URL strings (SARIF metadata, ESLint rule documentation links and bundled third-party text). Each is individually explained in .repo-contract/exceptions/dist-urls.json; they are inherent to the SARIF output and the bundled ESLint plugin.

exceptions.remediation: Revisit the individual URL records in dist-urls.json; the ones marked accepted-risk can be dropped later.
